title: TAKE IT DOWN Act (S.146)
summary: Federal law criminalizing the nonconsensual publication of real or AI-generated intimate images ('deepfake' pornography) and requiring covered online platforms to remove such content within 48 hours of a valid request. Signed into law on May 19, 2025 (119th Congress).
key_provisions: Criminalizes nonconsensual intimate imagery including AI deepfakes

title: DEFIANCE Act of 2024 (S.3696)

summary: Federal bill creating a civil right of action for victims of nonconsensual sexually explicit deepfakes to sue those who produce or distribute them. Passed the Senate unanimously in July 2024 but stalled in the House (118th Congress); reintroduced as a 2025 companion (H.R.3562).
